text:
The password security practice described in the text is highly insecure. Writing passwords on post-it notes and sticking them to a monitor is a significant risk because it exposes sensitive credentials to anyone who can see the workspace, including unauthorized individuals, cleaning staff, or visitors. This practice defeats the purpose of using complex passwords, as physical access to the note grants immediate access to the account.

Regarding the priority question: The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.
